title: UPSSSC Platoon Commander & Block Organizer Recruitment 2026 Online Form Live: 295 Posts Apply Now #UPSSSCPlatoonCommander2026 #UPSSSCBlockOrganizer #UPSSSC295Posts #UPSSSCAdvt102026 #SarkariNaukri
intro: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for the Post of Block Organizer / Platoon Commander in Home Guards Dept, Uttar Pradesh .(Advt.No. 10-Exam/2026) Recruitment 2026 for 295 Post for Mains Exam. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to UPSSSC Jobs. Online Apply Start On June 16, 2026 & Last Date for Application is July 6, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode.
Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree (Graduation) from any recognized university.
For departmental candidates – exemption may be applicable as per rules.)
Served in the Territorial Army for a minimum period of 2 years, OR
Obtained ‘B’ Certificate from National Cadet Corps (NCC), OR
Worked in the Home Guards Organization for a minimum period of 3 years
For More Details, Read the Official Notification.
For Age Relaxation, Read the Notification.
